title: phegopteris angustifolia
intro: Phegopteris angustifolia, commonly known as the Narrow Buckler Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris angustifolia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. The bioactive constituents of Phegopteris angustifolia have been studied for their potential therapeutic actions, including anti-cancer and anti-viral properties.
